blocks.p: A television set in reach is shown in the *Radio* tab of the *World* window, under a line that gives its name. Each of the three sets has a face of its own. The screen shows the picture, snow or the off-air cards.

caption: Figure 58-1
The Premium Technologies Television, playing a tape.

blocks.p: Under the screen are the set's controls: the tape slot with its keys, the tape counter, the channel with *CH*, *VOL*, *MUTE* and *POWER*.

marks.text: A tape plays on the screen: its title, then the lines it has shown.

sticky.text: Three television sets, each with its own face.

blocks.p: Off the dial, or just after a channel change, the screen shows snow. A station that is off the air shows its sign-off card; once it has stopped for good, it shows the standby card.

caption: Figure 58-2
The ValuTech set, top, and the Antique set, bottom.

marks.text: Off the dial, or just after a channel change, the screen shows snow.
A station that is off the air shows its sign-off card, or the standby card once it has stopped for good.
The knob pulls on and pushes off, and turns for the volume. The dial has twelve stops.

sticky.text: Picture, snow or the off-air cards.
